card.title: I Know How to Win This
card.instruction: Perform mastery of the rules, odds, and consequences while improvising every decision.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know this board game. I'm opening with the horse in the lake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There aren't horses. That's the scoring marker.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. I'm testing the scoring environment first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're not allowed to move it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. We have established a stable scoring environment.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 claims game mastery while misidentifying a marker; A3 and A5 convert corrections into planned tests.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 corrects the object, A3 absorbs it, B4 forbids movement, and A5 claims the prohibition was established intentionally.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 teach actual game constraints to an overconfident participant.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 immobility rule as a supposed discovery supporting A's expertise.

specificity.evidence: A1 board game and B2 marker identify the mistaken action without requiring the actual game name.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 stable scoring environment derives from B4 cannot move, sustaining the bluff.
